mentions.name: Localhero
mentions.description: This tool provides on-brand automated translations for product teams, running mainly as a GitHub Action that translates new strings on pull requests against a glossary and style guide. It has MCP integration so assistants like Claude Desktop and ChatGPT can find every key needing changes and organize the work while Localhero keeps the copy on-brand, letting PMs, designers and others bulk tweak copy without touching git. It has also deepened Lingui and Django support.
mentions.problem: Non-developers like PMs and designers want to bulk tweak product copy without touching git.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://localhero.ai, on-brand automated translations for product teams. It mainly runs as a GitHub Action, translates new strings on your PRs against your glossary and style guide. This month focus went mainly on MCP and stuff around that. Thinking a PM/designer/etc who wants to bulk tweak copy without touching git or similar.
mentions.author: arvida

mentions.name: Localhero
mentions.description: A GitHub Action that automates i18n translations for product teams, translating new strings on pull requests to match a brand voice and glossary. Includes a workflow and review layer with 'bring your own translations' support, a CLI, and improved Lingui support so projects using explicit IDs keep source text in the source locale's msgstr.
